svg.title: FowlCast marsh at dawn
svg.desc: A marsh contour map at dawn with a northwest wind. A blind sits on the upwind edge of a pond with an 18-decoy J-hook spread trailing downwind, and a line of ducks swings in from the north, circles downwind, and turns into the wind toward the landing pocket. Beside it, a mallard activity score of 0.81, blending a model score of 0.79 with a rules score of 0.84, broken down across ten factors led by cold-front timing.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: FRONT PASSED 18 H AGO · WIND NW 14 MPH
